notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35039675/4e6e87e0836fe2e001c442c6557d52b6b8d50f6f.png[/img]
Hello everyone!

We are very close to beginning of everything. Finally, after 3 years of development, Beyond Extinct will be released in Early Access just after 1 month, at 26.02.2020. 

With Beyond Extinct, we want to introduce an unlimited game for you. With Early Access, we will keep gather feedback to change and balance our game, while providing an already fun experience. And during this time we will keep updated regularly and communicate with you all the time. 

Keep following and be ready to a non-stop full action game!
